family.shared_definition: a self-propelled railway vehicle used for pulling trains along a rail track
family.neutral_stem: The railroad engineer climbed into the cab of the
family.semantic_notes: 'Locomotive' is the precise technical railway term, whereas 'engine' is the widespread metonymic count noun.

source_context_dev: The yard smelled strongly of petroleum fuel and exhaust after hours of idling on the transfer track. With the petroleum-fueled power unit preheated and ready for long-haul freight service across the state, operations commenced.
Petroleum exhaust drifted across the staging tracks as the long-haul fuel tank was filled to capacity. The crew finished inspecting the internal combustion traction system before the morning shift.

Liquid fuel had just been pumped into the undercarriage tanks ahead of the cross-country freight departure. Technicians confirmed that the internal combustion traction unit had reached optimal operating pressure.
The smell of refined petroleum hung in the cold morning air around the fueling island. Technicians completed their inspection of the standard regional freight hauler before departure.
target_context_dev: An immense steel superstructure towered over the platform, dwarfing the rail workers standing nearby. Its sheer bulk and towering frame were built specifically to pull several dozen loaded ore cars over the mountains.
Standing beside the towering multi-ton iron beast made the maintenance crew look tiny by comparison. It was an extraordinarily gigantic piece of rolling stock designed for maximum haulage capacity.

The colossal iron structure cast an enormous shadow across three parallel sets of tracks in the freight yard. Its gargantuan frame was constructed to haul record-breaking tonnage across the mountain pass.
Rail workers looked up in awe at the sheer height and immense tonnage of the newly arrived unit. The gigantic piece of equipment occupied the entire central siding.
source_context_test: The petroleum fueling depot had just topped off the tanks for a seven-hundred-mile nonstop journey. The standard combustion-powered hauler was cleared by yard control to proceed to the main branch.
A dark haze of refined fuel emissions rose above the terminal as technicians checked the traction alternators. The standard combustion unit stood idling quietly beside the service platform.

The fuel tender finished pumping hundreds of gallons of hydrocarbon distillate into the lower reservoir. All gauges showed that the long-distance freight unit was fully fueled and prepped for the run.
Odor from the fuel bay lingered near the siding where the cross-country unit stood ready. Ground crews verified that the fluid levels met the requirements for a long-distance haul.
target_context_test: The sheer physical dimensions of the iron titan dominated the surrounding terminal buildings. Built with an oversized chassis and extraordinary ballast weight, it was ready for the steepest grade.

Looking down the length of the yard, the monstrous iron machine completely obscured the view of the roundhouse behind it. Its titanic dimensions were engineered specifically for extreme freight loads.
The enormous metal bulk stood higher and wider than standard clearance markers along the spur track. This colossal piece of rolling machinery commanded the respect of everyone in the yard.
A towering iron silhouette stretched across the yard, casting a wide shadow over the adjacent switches. The gigantic hauler was ready to haul sixty fully loaded grain hoppers.
constructions.semantic_audit_notes: All combinations ('diesel locomotive', 'diesel engine', 'massive locomotive', 'massive engine') are natural railway collocations. Source contexts prime petroleum fuel/combustion and traditional long-haul train terminology, while target contexts prime colossal size, towering stature, and physical bulk.

source_context_dev: Mechanics had spent all weekend replacing worn brake shoes and fixing the cracked electrical conduits in the roundhouse. With all maintenance work signed off by the shop supervisor, the machine was returned to service.
After three weeks out of service for a major mechanical overhaul and rewiring, the unit was finally certified as roadworthy. The lead mechanic handed over the completed work order to the dispatcher.

The overhaul team had just replaced the fractured suspension springs and patched the coolant leak in the maintenance bay. Fully restored to factory operating condition, the unit was rolled back onto the active tracks.

Technicians had successfully corrected the steering bogie defects and replaced faulty sensors in the workshop. With the maintenance checklist completed, the equipment was certified for immediate active duty.
target_context_dev: The knuckled drawbar was firmly locked into the adjoining string of hopper cars with the safety pins secured. Air brake hoses were securely connected between the lead unit and the rest of the train.
Ground crewmen signaled that the heavy steel latch had latched securely onto the head of the seventy-car manifest. The mechanical connection and pneumatic lines were firmly joined.
The mechanical link between the lead hauler and the grain wagons clicked shut with a loud metallic snap. Shunters verified that the interlocking knuckle joint was properly engaged.
Ground switchers checked that the physical connection to the first container flatcar was tight and locked in position. The tensioned hitch and pneumatic connections were fully secure for the trip.
source_context_test: The workshop staff had spent all afternoon mending the hydraulic lines and tightening loose structural bolts. After receiving a clean bill of mechanical health from the inspector, the unit was moved outside.

Following extensive refurbishment of the traction gears and replacement of damaged electrical relays, the unit passed its safety audit. The maintenance foreman cleared it to re-enter daily freight service.
Service bay personnel had finally patched the fractured exhaust manifold and restored the air brake compressor. The equipment was pronounced ready to roll after undergoing thorough diagnostics.

Days of meticulous restoration work on the suspension and electrical controls had just wrapped up in the repair shed. The workshop crew signed the release form allowing it back into mainline rotation.
target_context_test: The mechanical drawhead had engaged with the freight consist behind it, locking the train into a single continuous chain. Shunters confirmed that the interlocking jaw had closed completely.
Rail yard workers ensured that the central draft gear was linked tightly to the front hopper car. The adjoining pneumatic brake lines hissed as the connection was pressurized.
The steel clasp at the rear had securely gripped the matching knuckle of the trailing boxcars. Switchmen confirmed that the physical attachment was locked and pinned for mainline travel.
Yard workers fastened the safety chains and connected the pneumatic brake line to the linked consist. The mechanical connection between the front vehicle and the cars behind it was complete.
constructions.semantic_audit_notes: All four combinations ('repaired locomotive', 'repaired engine', 'coupled locomotive', 'coupled engine') form perfectly standard rail industry phrases. Source contexts emphasize roundhouse maintenance, restoration, and mechanical overhaul, while target contexts emphasize draft gears, knuckles, and train attachment.

source_context_dev: The train was hurtling along the open straightaway at eighty miles per hour, rushing to make up lost schedule time. Wind roared past the windshield as the velocity indicator climbed steadily on the downhill run.
Moving at rapid velocity across the flat prairie corridor, the train tore past crossing signals in a rapid blur. The speedometer needle pushed toward the maximum permissible velocity.
The high-velocity express was racing against the clock down the express track to beat incoming passenger traffic. Rapid motion rattled the windows as the unit tore past the rural stations.
Blurring past milepost markers at extreme velocity, the train rapidly gained momentum down the clear mainline. The throttle remained wide open to make up for earlier track delays.
target_context_dev: Towing tens of thousands of tons of raw iron ore, the massive consist put tremendous downward force on the steel rails. The ballast groaned under the immense gravitational load of the dense freight.
The railbed groaned under the tremendous downward pressure of thousands of tons of dense cargo. Track sensors registered maximum axle loading as the freight consist crawled over the bridge.
Dragging twenty thousand tons of crushed gravel, the train moved with deliberate slowness down the spur. The sheer downward weight of the dense industrial payload taxed the rails to their limit.

A massive payload of bulk minerals weighed down the entire consist, requiring immense traction effort from the rails. Track inspectors monitored the rail deflection under the extreme downward tonnage.
source_context_test: Rushing down the corridor at top velocity, the priority manifest blew past trackside signals in a swift blur. The engineer monitored the rapid acceleration on the clear stretch of rail ahead.
The express train was tearing down the valley route at breakneck velocity to meet its delivery deadline. Trackside dust swirled wildly in the turbulence created by the fast-moving train.
Flying past countryside crossings at maximum allowable velocity, the train made rapid progress across the division. The rhythmic clicking of the rails accelerated into a continuous roar.
Sprinting down the mainline tangent at rapid speed, the train quickly covered the remaining distance to the junction. Everything along the right-of-way whipped past in a rapid streak.
target_context_test: The immense tonnage of eighty loaded coal hoppers exerted massive downward pressure on the underlying roadbed. Rail joints creaked under the extreme burden of the laden freight train.

Carrying an extraordinary payload of solid steel slabs, the consist placed an unprecedented downward strain on the tracks. The tremendous ballast weight was evident as the train crawled past the station.
The sheer deadweight of the fully laden freight cars caused the underlying wooden ties to settle into the gravel ballast. Every axle bore the maximum permissible load of dense mineral rock.
Tens of thousands of tons of raw cargo created enormous downward ballast friction along the steep mountain line. The immense deadweight demanded maximum tractive effort from the head-end equipment.
constructions.semantic_audit_notes: All four cross combinations ('speeding locomotive', 'speeding engine', 'heavy locomotive', 'heavy engine') are grammatically sound and semantically sensible. Source contexts focus on rapid velocity, high speed, and rushing to beat schedules; target contexts focus on extreme tonnage, deadweight, and high axle-load.
